title: Chip Industry Week In Review
summary: 该周报汇总：Nvidia董事会称正调查CEO，媒体称约600,000颗H200芯片滞留香港待批赴华、HBM经走私流入中国；Micron据报因劳工纠纷暂停台湾$4.5B内存厂建设且未确认；三星据报扩产HBM基础裸片。

articleBody:
Top Of The Week

Nvidia‘s board of directors issued a statement that it was investigating CEO Jensen Huang, following his admission that he had an intimate relationship with a purported Chinese spy. The affair surfaced as part of investigation by the U.S. government into illegal shipments of Nvidia AI chips to China, according to the New York Times.

Meanwhile, approximately 600,000 Nvidia H200 AI chips are being held in Hong Kong awaiting approval for shipment to mainland China, according to Reuters. Beijing has limited imports in an effort to reduce reliance on U.S. technology and encourage adoption of domestically developed processors.

HBM from Samsung and SK hynix is reportedly reaching Chinese AI chip developers through smuggling operations that exploit U.S. export-control loopholes. According to The Information, intermediaries package HBM with low-performance server processors, ship the combined components to China, and then remove the memory for resale, including to customers of Huawei.

Micron reportedly paused construction of a $4.5B memory-chip plant in Taiwan due to a prolonged labor dispute, according to Bloomberg. Micron has not confirmed the suspension, and the effect on its longer-term Taiwan manufacturing plans remains unclear.

Samsung Electronics is reportedly planning to expand advanced foundry capacity for HBM base dies at two locations.

In South Korea, the company reportedly plans a new foundry facility at Giheung, with 2nm and 4nm production lines and an estimated ~US$17B investment, along with a possible advanced packaging expansion.

Separately, Samsung reportedly secured orders from AMD and Nvidia for 2nm HBM base dies to be produced at a proposed second foundry in Taylor, Texas, with mass production targeted for 2030. Note: Samsung has not confirmed the reported Giheung investment or Taylor customer orders.

Oracle canceled a 5-year agreement worth an estimated $7B to provide Tencent access to up to 100,000 advanced AI chips through data centers in Southeast Asia, following pressure from the Trump administration, according to the Financial Times. U.S. officials raised concerns about Chinese companies accessing advanced processors through overseas cloud services, while officials in China’s Guangdong province urged Tencent to use domestically developed chips.

Bosch plans to establish a dedicated semiconductor division in January 2028, expanding its foundry business and opening more manufacturing capacity to external customers. The company is targeting €5B in semiconductor sales by 2030 and plans to expand its semiconductor test center in Penang, Malaysia, by the mid-2030s.

Marvell‘s pending acquisition of Lumentum, initially valued at $115B, is drawing mixed reactions, with analysts seeing opportunities to challenge Broadcom in AI optical interconnects, but also raising concerns about supplier concentration and customer relationships. Questions about the purchase price and regulatory approval have added to investor concerns.

U.S. election results raised concerns about tighter restrictions on data center development, particularly in major markets such as Texas and Ohio, as well as increased congressional oversight of AI, including AI safety, cybersecurity, and industry practices. Restrictions that delay or reduce data center construction could weaken demand for AI accelerators, HBM, and networking chips, and increased regulatory scrutiny could create additional uncertainty for AI infrastructure investment. (See chip stock impacts here.)

More acquisitions and deals

Onsemi confirmed it plans to acquire Ferric, developer of integrated voltage regulators, for $600M in cash, plus up to $175M in milestone payments.

Entegris acquired Advanced Abrasives and announced plans for a new SiC materials manufacturing line in Taiwan. The company also partnered with Element Six to develop diamond-based thermal-management materials for advanced packaging and expanded its deal with Kioxia on BiCS Flash 3D flash memory.

Supermicro is initially planning to use 10,000 SambaNova SN50 RDUs for its new AI disaggregated inference systems as part of a strategic collaboration.

China’s biggest EDA company, Empyrean, plans to acquire a ~50.4% stake in Easy-Logic for US$33M.

Unconfirmed: Mitsui Chemicals reportedly plans to buy JSR, semiconductor materials maker, for at least $8B.

Two acquisitions finalized: ADI‘s purchase of Alif Semiconductor, adding its AI-native MCU and fusion processors, and Forge Nano‘s acquisition of HZO for its nanoscale coating platforms.

Reports and analysis

Global semiconductor sales reached $518B in Q3, up 24% from Q2, according to the SIA/WSTS. September sales were up 147% year over year.

Worldwide silicon wafer shipments increased 13.4% year over year in Q3, reports SEMI.

Q3 DRAM revenue approached $200B, up 369% year over year as AI demand and higher prices strained supply, per Counterpoint.

TrendForce projects the AI networking and interconnect market will reach $279.8B in 2027.

AI data centers are moving toward 800 VDC power distribution as rack power rises toward megawatt levels, with Nvidia, Google, Microsoft and other industry participants working through OCP on common architectures and interfaces.

Earnings

Revenue growth/decline year over year:

Arm up 27%, Arteris up 48%, AMD up 45%, Bruker up ~2%, Coherent up 50%, GlobalFoundries up 13%, Lattice up 118%, Nova up 28%, onsemi up 11%, PDF Solutions up 20%, Qnity sales up 22%, Qualcomm down 8%, and Tower up 33%.

Global

Americas

UC San Diego and Qualcomm launched a $750K AI-driven chip-design research initiative, funded by a $500K Qualcomm gift and $250K in UCSD matching funds, focused on AI methods for SoC design, processor architectures, hardware accelerators, memory systems, and interconnects.

CSIS examines Albany NanoTech as a model for semiconductor technology clusters, highlighting shared R&D infrastructure, industry partnerships, and workforce development supporting sub-2nm technologies, advanced packaging, photonics, and quantum systems.

The OCP Foundation is opening nominations for project leads across all 12 top-level OCP Projects, ranging from hardware management to the AI computing continuum.

Europe

The European Semiconductor Industry Association (ESIA) called for dedicated semiconductor funding under the EU’s 2028–2034 budget, including support for R&D, pilot production, advanced packaging, and industrial deployment. The association urged policymakers to coordinate national and EU funding, preserve the Chips Joint Undertaking’s cross-sector role, and ease restrictions on intellectual property transfers within multinational companies.

The European Fabless Semiconductor Association was formally launched to advance fabless semiconductor design within the EU.

The EU launched a European Chip Design Platform (EuroCDP) with €525M to stimulate new chip design companies.

Synopsys and the EU Chips JU signed a deal to expand access to its EDA software for semiconductor startups and research teams through the EuroCDP.

Asia

South Korea reaffirmed plans to spend ₩21.3T (US$16B) on AI and major initiatives covering semiconductors, physical AI, and data centers, in its proposed 2027 budget, nearly doubling this year’s allocation.

Panasonic Industry plans to invest about ¥92B ($583M) to expand AI-related materials production and R&D, including circuit-board materials, capacitors and semiconductor packaging materials.

Two workers were killed and five injured in an explosion and fire at Panasonic Industrial Devices Materials‘ factory in Hsinchu, Taiwan. The facility produces PCB and semiconductor packaging materials. The cause and production impact have not been determined yet.

South Korea’s Techwing plans to invest approximately ₩52.6B ($39M) in a new semiconductor equipment factory in Cheonan to expand production of memory test handlers and HBM cube probers.

Perspective: Putting AI To The Test

New Technologies

Automotive and physical AI

Infineon introduced its first automotive MCU platform based on the RISC-V architecture, adding hardware-based physical protection and crypto agility, with support planned for post-quantum security requirements.

Infineon and Qualcomm are collaborating on a microcontroller-based subsystem for Snapdragon Ride reference platforms used in central car computers for automated driving and digital cockpit applications.

STMicro announced a new microcontroller portfolio covering industrial, automotive, and physical AI applications.

Test, measurement

Keysight released XR3, a low-profile 14-bit oscilloscope designed to increase measurement capacity in rack-based test systems.

Siemens introduced an automated component model extraction solution developed with Bosch that cuts frequency-response-function measurement time by up to 93% and produces ISO 20270-compliant models for virtual NVH development.

AI hardware & memory

Qualcomm completed hardware validation of its high-bandwidth compute (HBC) silicon, exercising the full memory read/write path and near-memory computations.

Cerabyte completed S3 integration testing of its ceramic data storage within established object-storage workflows, in collaboration with CERN openlab.

Design

Arteris exceeded 1,000 customer silicon design starts using its interconnect IP, and released a report showing the evolution of SoC, ASIC, FPGA, and MCU designs across key markets.

Research

MCL, PVA TePla and ASE researchers developed an AI-based image-enhancement method for detecting flip-chip interconnect defects. By improving scanning acoustic microscopy images, the method increased detection of cracks and delamination in extreme-low-k dielectric layers from 5.2% to 100% in tests involving 19 defects across three packages.

TU Munich, Applied Materials et al. evaluated cryogenic 2nm GAA transistors and superconducting interconnects for energy-efficient AI computing. Using a calibrated chip-design flow, they reported a 3x performance increase and 7.7x improvement in energy efficiency for a modeled AI accelerator’s compute fabric, excluding memory, data movement, and refrigeration power.

ETH Zurich-led researchers benchmarked 10 commercial sub-watt edge AI devices, comparing inference performance and energy consumption across convolutional neural networks and small vision transformers. The study found that memory traffic, rather than computational workload, was the primary factor determining latency on the tested neural-network accelerators, highlighting the importance of data movement in low-power AI hardware design.

HUST and PolyU researchers developed annealing-free ferroelectric transistors with ultrathin oxide-semiconductor channels for NVM and neuromorphic computing. The devices achieved a memory window of up to 20.6V, endurance of 10⁶ cycles, and stable 6-bit operation across 64 states. A neuromorphic network evaluation achieved 93.02% recognition accuracy.

Security

Government security news

ENISA issued new EU cybersecurity-certification guidance for secure elements, outlining how cryptographic security services can be evaluated for use across different chip platforms.

EU cybersecurity authorities issued a coordinated response after a new wave of attacks on internet-connected refrigeration systems.

Japan’s METI and IPA are participating in a new effort to align security requirements for connected hardware under Japan’s JC-STAR program and the EU Cyber Resilience Act.

Alerts and attacks

AMD issued security bulletins covering a newly discovered EDK II PXE driver vulnerability that can allow pre-boot code execution and a contention-based side-channel technique for exploiting known vulnerabilities in AMD CPUs.

Dell issued BIOS updates for a critical Qualcomm chipset vulnerability affecting five Latitude, Inspiron, and XPS systems. The flaw can cause memory corruption when a malformed RSA key is imported into Qualcomm’s Keystore.

Google banned Videostrong Technology from making certified Android devices after its security researchers determined that the company was responsible for creating an XCPE backdoor that enrolled 1.3 million set-top boxes into a criminal botnet.

CISA’s alerts for the week are here.

Security offering and deals

Vietnam has its first-ever homegrown security chip after government-backed Viettel Group successfully integrated a domestically developed cryptographic algorithm into silicon.

u-blox announced that it will integrate Kudelski Labs’ embedded security IP into its future chipsets.

Chinese tech giant Tencent released Hy4, its powerful new open-source AI model. Amid growing concerns about agentic hacking, the company said it limited the model’s cybersecurity training data to defensive material only.

Security technical papers

NC State and Princeton researchers proposed a 3D-stacked hardware shield to protect post-quantum cryptography accelerators from side-channel attacks. The design stacks a guard layer above the cryptographic hardware, using decoy-key activity and physical shielding to obscure power leakage from NTT computations.

Trending Video

Accelerating Plug-And-Play Prototyping In Chiplet-Based Designs: Purna Mohanty, CEO of SignatureIP, talks about the impact of chiplets and shared memory resources, the challenges of version control across multiple flavors of I/O, and the challenges engineering teams face when hardware-accelerated tools are running at different speeds than the actual design.

Quantum Hardware

New launches

Universal Quantum launched its iQPU quantum processor, combining a large trapped-ion compute surface, ultra-low-noise integrated control electronics, and chip-to-chip interfaces designed to scale quantum computing systems. The processor is manufactured on a commercial 200mm semiconductor production line.

IBM, ORNL, and AMD opened a new co-design platform for quantum error correction at IBM’s quantum facility in New York, co-locating the 120-qubit IBM Quantum Nighthawk with ORNL’s Umbra HPC system.

Fig. 1: ORNL’s Umbra HPC system. Source: Oak Ridge National Lab

Advances

Researchers from Quantum Motion, UCL, and others demonstrated a superconducting circuit element fabricated using a commercial CMOS process. The titanium-nitride device functions as a compact superinductor and was integrated with a silicon quantum dot to enable sensitive RF charge detection, potentially supporting more compact readout hardware for semiconductor spin qubits.

University of Regensburg-led researchers demonstrated a real-time feedback technique that reduced superconducting-qubit operation errors by approximately 54%, from 0.14% to 0.065%. The approach identifies changes in qubit resonance frequency associated with material defects and adjusts control signals to improve reliability.

Alice & Bob reported extended bit-flip lifetimes in superconducting cat qubits, averaging 44 minutes on a single-qubit test device and reaching 189 to 252 minutes on selected qubits in its 12-qubit Helium 2 processor. The preliminary results demonstrate strong suppression of bit-flip errors during idle operation, with performance during error-correction operations still to be validated.

Workforce, Education

The U.S. Department of Labor opened applications for a $40M apprenticeship incentive fund that includes semiconductor fabrication among several high-growth sectors. Registered apprenticeship sponsors can receive up to $6K per eligible new apprentice.

UCLA named the first 10 doctoral fellows in its Semiconductor Hub, with research spanning 3D ICs, advanced packaging, silicon photonics, compute-in-memory, and AI hardware. Fellows will also intern with one of the Hub’s industry partners, including Synopsys, GlobalFoundries, and others.

In a new Semiconductor Engineering roundtable, industry experts discuss how AI is changing expectations for new engineering graduates. Demand for electrical engineers remains strong, but AI agents are taking over some traditional junior-level tasks, raising expectations for practical experience, AI fluency, and the ability to tackle higher-level engineering work earlier in their careers.

U.S. community colleges are expanding semiconductor technician training programs as the industry faces a potential shortage of 157,000 workers by 2030, according to the Associated Press. More than 200 colleges and universities are coordinating with semiconductor manufacturers, including TSMC, Intel, Samsung, and SK hynix, to develop hands-on training programs supporting new U.S. fabs.

The processor is manufactured on a commercial 200mm semiconductor production line.

Advances

items: Researchers from Quantum Motion, UCL, and others demonstrated a superconducting circuit element fabricated using a commercial CMOS process. The titanium-nitride device functions as a compact superinductor and was integrated with a silicon quantum dot to enable sensitive RF charge detection, potentially supporting more compact readout hardware for semiconductor spin qubits.

University of Regensburg-led researchers demonstrated a real-time feedback technique that reduced superconducting-qubit operation errors by approximately 54%, from 0.14% to 0.065%. The approach identifies changes in qubit resonance frequency associated with material defects and adjusts control signals to improve reliability.

Alice & Bob reported extended bit-flip lifetimes in superconducting cat qubits, averaging 44 minutes on a single-qubit test device and reaching 189 to 252 minutes on selected qubits in its 12-qubit Helium 2 processor. The preliminary results demonstrate strong suppression of bit-flip errors during idle operation, with performance during error-correction operations still to be validated.

Alice & Bob 报告称超导猫量子比特的比特翻转寿命延长，在单量子比特测试器件上平均为 44 minutes，在其 12-qubit Helium 2 处理器中选定量子比特上达到 189 to 252 minutes。初步结果表明空闲运行期间比特翻转错误得到强抑制，纠错操作期间的性能仍有待验证。

本周要闻

Nvidia董事会发布声明称，正在调查CEO Jensen Huang，此前他承认与一名据称是中国间谍的人存在亲密关系。据《纽约时报》报道，这一事件是在美国政府调查Nvidia AI芯片非法运往中国过程中浮出水面的。

与此同时，据Reuters报道，约600,000颗Nvidia H200 AI芯片正滞留在香港，等待批准运往中国大陆。北京方面已限制进口，以减少对美国技术的依赖，并鼓励采用国内开发的处理器。

据报道，Samsung和SK hynix的HBM正通过利用美国出口管制漏洞的走私活动流向中国AI芯片开发商。据The Information报道，中介将HBM与低性能服务器处理器封装在一起，将组合后的组件运往中国，然后拆下内存转售，包括销售给华为的客户。

据Bloomberg报道，Micron因长期劳工纠纷暂停了在台湾一座价值$4.5B的存储芯片工厂的建设。Micron尚未确认停工，此事对其长期台湾制造计划的影响仍不清楚。

据报道，Samsung Electronics计划在两个地点扩大用于HBM base die的先进晶圆代工产能。

在韩国，该公司据报道计划在Giheung新建一座晶圆代工厂，包含2nm和4nm生产线，预计投资约US$17B，并可能扩大先进封装产能。

另外，据报道Samsung已从AMD和Nvidia获得2nm HBM base die订单，将在拟建于德克萨斯州Taylor的第二座晶圆代工厂生产，目标于2030年量产。注：Samsung尚未确认报道中的Giheung投资或Taylor客户订单。

据《金融时报》报道，在特朗普政府施压后，Oracle取消了一项价值估计$7B的5年协议，该协议原计划让Tencent通过东南亚的数据中心获取最多100,000颗先进AI芯片。美国官员对中国公司通过海外云服务获取先进处理器表示担忧，而中国广东省官员则敦促Tencent使用国内开发的芯片。

Bosch计划于2028年1月设立专门的半导体部门，扩大其晶圆代工业务，并向外部客户开放更多制造产能。该公司目标是到2030年实现€5B半导体销售额，并计划到2030年代中期扩建其位于马来西亚Penang的半导体测试中心。

Marvell待完成的对Lumentum的收购最初估值$115B，正引发褒贬不一的反应，分析师认为有机会在AI光互连领域挑战Broadcom，但也引发了对供应商集中度和客户关系的担忧。对收购价格和监管批准的疑问加剧了投资者的担忧。

美国选举结果引发了对数据中心开发面临更严格限制的担忧，尤其是在德克萨斯州和俄亥俄州等主要市场，同时也引发了对国会加强对AI监督的担忧，包括AI安全、网络安全和行业实践。延迟或减少数据中心建设的限制可能削弱对AI加速器、HBM和网络芯片的需求，而监管审查加强可能给AI基础设施投资带来额外不确定性。（芯片股影响见此。）

更多收购与交易

Onsemi确认计划以$600M现金收购集成稳压器开发商Ferric，外加最高$175M的里程碑付款。

Entegris收购了Advanced Abrasives，并宣布计划在台湾新建一条SiC材料生产线。该公司还与Element Six合作开发用于先进封装的基于金刚石的热管理材料，并扩大了与Kioxia在BiCS Flash 3D闪存方面的协议。

Supermicro最初计划为其新的AI分离式推理系统使用10,000个SambaNova SN50 RDU，作为战略合作的一部分。

中国最大的EDA公司华大九天（Empyrean）计划以3300万美元收购Easy-Logic约50.4%的股份。

全球

美洲

加州大学圣地亚哥分校与Qualcomm启动了一项75万美元的AI驱动芯片设计研究计划，由Qualcomm捐赠50万美元和UCSD配套资金25万美元资助，重点关注用于SoC设计、处理器架构、硬件加速器、内存系统和互连的AI方法。

CSIS将Albany NanoTech作为半导体技术集群的范例进行研究，强调其共享研发基础设施、产业合作伙伴关系以及支持2nm以下技术、先进封装、光子学和量子系统的劳动力发展。

OCP基金会正在开放全部12个顶级OCP项目的项目负责人提名，范围从硬件管理到AI计算连续体。

欧洲

欧洲半导体产业协会（ESIA）呼吁在欧盟2028—2034年预算中设立专门的半导体资金，包括支持研发、试产、先进封装和工业部署。该协会敦促政策制定者协调各国与欧盟资金，维护芯片联合执行体的跨行业作用，并放宽跨国企业内部知识产权转让的限制。

欧洲无晶圆半导体协会正式成立，以推进欧盟内的无晶圆半导体设计。

欧盟启动了欧洲芯片设计平台（EuroCDP），投入5.25亿欧元，以扶持新的芯片设计公司。

Synopsys与EU Chips JU签署协议，通过EuroCDP扩大半导体初创公司和研究团队获取其EDA软件的渠道。

亚洲

韩国在其拟议的2027年预算中重申，计划在AI及涵盖半导体、物理AI和数据中心的重大举措上支出₩21.3T（US$16B），几乎为今年拨款的两倍。

Panasonic Industry计划投资约¥92B（$583M），以扩大AI相关材料的生产和研发，包括电路板材料、电容器和半导体封装材料。

Panasonic Industrial Devices Materials在新竹的工厂发生爆炸和火灾，造成两名工人死亡、五人受伤。该工厂生产PCB和半导体封装材料。事故原因和生产影响尚未确定。

韩国的Techwing计划投资约₩52.6B（$39M）在Cheonan新建半导体设备工厂，以扩大存储器测试分选机和HBM cube prober的产量。

汽车与物理AI

Infineon推出了其首个基于RISC-V架构的汽车MCU平台，增加基于硬件的物理保护和密码敏捷性，并计划支持后量子安全需求。

Infineon与Qualcomm正在合作开发基于微控制器的子系统，用于Snapdragon Ride参考平台，该平台用于自动驾驶和数字座舱应用的中央汽车计算机。

STMicro宣布新的微控制器产品组合，覆盖工业、汽车和物理AI应用。

测试、测量

Keysight发布XR3，一款低高度14位示波器，旨在提高机架式测试系统的测量能力。

Siemens推出了与Bosch共同开发的自动化部件模型提取解决方案，可将频率响应函数测量时间最多缩短93%，并为虚拟NVH开发生成符合ISO 20270的模型。

AI硬件与存储器

Qualcomm完成了其高带宽计算（HBC）硅片的硬件验证，测试了完整的内存读写路径和近存计算。

Cerabyte与CERN openlab合作，完成了其陶瓷数据存储在既有对象存储工作流中的S3集成测试。

设计

Arteris使用其互连IP的客户芯片设计启动项目已超过1,000个，并发布报告展示SoC、ASIC、FPGA和MCU设计在关键市场的演进。

研究

MCL、PVA TePla和ASE的研究人员开发了一种基于AI的图像增强方法，用于检测倒装芯片互连缺陷。该方法通过改善扫描声学显微镜图像，在涉及三个封装中19个缺陷的测试中，将超低k介电层中裂纹和分层检测率从5.2%提高到100%。

TU Munich、Applied Materials等评估了用于能效AI计算的低温2nm GAA晶体管和超导互连。使用经过校准的芯片设计流程，他们报告称，对于建模的AI加速器计算结构，在排除存储器、数据移动和制冷功耗的情况下，性能提高3倍，能效提高7.7倍。

由ETH Zurich领导的研究人员对10款商用亚瓦级边缘AI设备进行了基准测试，比较了卷积神经网络和小型视觉Transformer上的推理性能和能耗。研究发现，在所测试的神经网络加速器上，决定延迟的主要因素是存储器流量而非计算工作量，凸显了数据移动在低功耗AI硬件设计中的重要性。

HUST 与 PolyU 的研究人员开发出免退火铁电晶体管，采用超薄氧化物半导体沟道，面向 NVM 与神经形态计算。这些器件的记忆窗口最高达 20.6V，耐久性达 10⁶ 次循环，并可在 64 个状态上稳定实现 6 位操作。神经形态网络评估实现了 93.02% 的识别准确率。

安全

政府安全动态

ENISA 发布了针对安全元件的新欧盟网络安全认证指南，阐述了如何评估密码安全服务以便在不同芯片平台上使用。

在针对联网制冷系统的新一轮攻击之后，欧盟网络安全机构发布了协调应对措施。

日本 METI 与 IPA 正在参与一项新工作，旨在使日本 JC-STAR 计划与欧盟《网络韧性法案》下联网硬件的安全要求保持一致。

警报与攻击

AMD 发布安全公告，涉及新发现的 EDK II PXE 驱动程序漏洞（可导致启动前代码执行），以及一种基于争用的侧信道技术，可用于利用 AMD CPU 中的已知漏洞。

戴尔针对影响五款 Latitude、Inspiron 和 XPS 系统的关键高通芯片组漏洞发布了 BIOS 更新。当畸形 RSA 密钥被导入高通 Keystore 时，该缺陷可导致内存损坏。

谷歌禁止 Videostrong Technology 生产经过认证的 Android 设备，此前其安全研究人员认定该公司负责创建了一个 XCPE 后门，将 130 万台机顶盒纳入犯罪僵尸网络。

CISA 本周的警报见此。

安全产品与交易

在政府支持的 Viettel Group 成功将自主开发的密码算法集成到硅片之后，越南拥有了首个本土安全芯片。

u-blox 宣布将把 Kudelski Labs 的嵌入式安全 IP 集成到其未来芯片组中。

中国科技巨头腾讯发布了其强大的新开源 AI 模型 Hy4。在人们对智能体黑客攻击日益担忧之际，该公司称其将该模型的网络安全训练数据限制为仅防御性材料。

安全技术论文

NC State 与普林斯顿大学的研究人员提出了一种 3D 堆叠硬件防护层，用于保护后量子密码加速器免受侧信道攻击。该设计在密码硬件上方堆叠一层防护层，利用诱饵密钥活动和物理屏蔽来掩盖 NTT 计算产生的功耗泄漏。

进展

来自 Quantum Motion、UCL 及其他机构的研究人员展示了一种使用商业 CMOS 工艺制造的超导电路元件。该氮化钛器件可作为紧凑型超电感，并与硅量子点集成，以实现灵敏的射频电荷检测，有望为半导体自旋量子比特支持更紧凑的读出硬件。

由雷根斯堡大学牵头的研究人员展示了一种实时反馈技术，可将超导量子比特的操作错误降低约 54%，从 0.14% 降至 0.065%。该方法识别与材料缺陷相关的量子比特谐振频率变化，并调整控制信号以提高可靠性。

Alice & Bob 报告称超导猫量子比特的比特翻转寿命延长，在单量子比特测试器件上平均为 44 minutes，在其 12-qubit Helium 2 处理器中选定量子比特上达到 189 to 252 minutes。初步结果表明空闲运行期间比特翻转错误得到强抑制，纠错操作期间的性能仍有待验证。

劳动力与教育

美国劳工部开放了 $40M 学徒激励基金的申请，该基金将半导体制造列为几个高增长行业之一。注册学徒计划的赞助方可为每名符合条件的新学徒获得最高 $6K。

UCLA 公布了其半导体中心（Semiconductor Hub）首批 10 名博士研究员，研究方向涵盖 3D IC、先进封装、硅光子学、存内计算和 AI 硬件。这些研究员还将在该中心的行业合作伙伴之一实习，包括 Synopsys、GlobalFoundries 等。

在最新一期 Semiconductor Engineering 圆桌讨论中，行业专家讨论了 AI 如何改变对新工程毕业生的期望。对电气工程师的需求仍然强劲，但 AI 智能体正在接管一些传统的初级任务，从而提高了对实践经验、AI 熟练度以及在职业生涯更早期承担更高层次工程工作的期望。

据 Associated Press 报道，随着该行业到 2030 年面临潜在的 157,000 名工人短缺，美国社区学院正在扩大半导体技术员培训项目。200 多所学院和大学正与半导体制造商协调，包括 TSMC、Intel、Samsung 和 SK hynix，以开发支持美国新建晶圆厂的实践培训项目。
